source.citation: Iqbal et al., CornWeed Dataset: A dataset for training maize and weed object detectors for agricultural machines, Zenodo 2023, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7961764; companion paper DOI 10.15439/2023f2125.

duplicates.phash_method: 64-bit pHash, compare equal-resolution images, Hamming<=6; candidates only, not proof of duplicate

weed_only_mapping.verified_by: maize_dataset/data.yaml names=['Weeds','Maize']; README says zero-indexed; COCO categories id=1 Weeds,id=2 Maize.
weed_only_mapping.validity: Technically valid as a one-class remap for annotated weed boxes. Maize annotations dropped; this treats maize/crop as background. Before using, check unannotated weeds/coverage in crop-box-rich scenes; labels alone cannot establish completeness.
